component.name: Plasma Impresario
component.summary: Клиент электронной почты по протоколу IMAP
Клієнтська програма для роботи з електронною поштою IMAP

description.p: Plasma Impresario is an email program ("client") based on Trojitá, specialized in giving fast and efficient access to mailboxes over the IMAP protocol. An IMAP mail server stores messages and allows clients to fetch messages to the local computer when asked for.

It prioritizes efficiency, speed and open standards above other goals. Plasma Impresario also aims to be multi-platform. Plasma Impresario is a stand-alone program, not part of a "personal information manager" suite.
What could make Plasma Impresario interesting for you:
